title: The Servant Duty Schedule
description:
📂 Evidence Folder #7:
Butler: 8:00 PM - 10:00 PM
Footman: 10:00 PM - 12:00 AM
Guard: 12:00 AM - 2:00 AM
Murder occurred at 11:15 PM.
question: Which servant was on duty at the time of the murder?
hints: Footman shift covers 10:00 PM to 12:00 AM.
solution: The Footman was on duty during his 10:00 PM - 12:00 AM shift.
